# unifi_execute_port_action (Action)

Executes an action on a switch port. Actions are experimental in Terraform and require Terraform v1.14 or later.

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "unifi_execute_port_action" "power_cycle_port" {
  config {
    site_id   = var.unifi_site_id
    device_id = "device-123"
    port_idx  = 1
    action    = "POWER_CYCLE"
  }
}

resource "terraform_data" "trigger" {
  input = timestamp()

  lifecycle {
    action_trigger {
      events  = [after_update]
      actions = [action.unifi_execute_port_action.power_cycle_port]
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `action` (String) Port action to execute (supported: POWER_CYCLE).
- `device_id` (String) Device identifier that owns the port.
- `port_idx` (Number) Port index on the device.

### Optional

- `site_id` (String) Site identifier (defaults to provider site_id).
- `timeout_seconds` (Number) Timeout in seconds for the action request (default: 1800).
